peerjs.min.js
  Library : PeerJS 1.5.4 (browser-to-browser connections for Live mode, see js/live.js)
  Source  : https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js
  Size    : 92,865 bytes
  SHA-256 : ad5d8870d1e389914f9cba8d35be313c4327c69ee0a221e482e9bf7621136fe5
  Saved   : 2026-11-25. Kept in the repo (not loaded from the internet) so a compromised CDN can never run code in this site.
  To update: download the new version, check it, replace this file and these notes.
  Note: PeerJS still uses the free PeerJS broker (0.peerjs.com) to introduce two computers. The broker never sees slides or chat.
